document_title: LUM-LIG-DES-8G8J Contemporary Linen Desk Lamp - Technical Manual & SOP Rev 4.2
author_provenance: Global Hardware Safety & Lighting Systems Engineering
document_summary: This document outlines standard operating procedures and electrical thermal safety limits for SKU LUM-LIG-DES-8G8J. It provides operational safety guidance regarding 120V AC thermal and electrical shock risks. Additionally, it establishes compliance verification across UL-153, FCC Part 15, CE-LVD, and RoHS standards under a 10-year archival lifecycle.
